title: Draft useful-insight evidence-link observation adapter

findings.observation: journey.useful-insight requires named question/insight contracts. Implemented briefs are purpose-scoped context packets only (session/recall/correction/audit). The go-no-go journey adapter remains NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
findings.invariant: No fake surface; do not treat context_packet as a named insight contract.

findings.observation: Working-knowledge lines stamp claim_id, confidence, sensitivity, taint, authority, and status. Provenance event ids are required to serve but are not printed. Envelope has no structured claims array.
findings.invariant: Packet text is not a complete evidence citation.

findings.observation: RFC sketch uses CANON/QUOTED headings and c= on canon lines. Implementation uses ## headings; canon stamps are s=/taint=/auth=/origin=; confidence is on claims only; header includes principal= and at=.
findings.invariant: Observers must use the implemented grammar.

findings.observation: identity-authority-unavailable is always appended when claims are included and does not withhold packed model-free claims.
findings.invariant: Unavailable identity authority is distinct from missing claim evidence.

findings.observation: {"claims":[]} is valid ok emptiness and may advance the extract cursor. unavailable must not be treated as emptiness.
findings.invariant: Failure is never representable as empty success.
